list_users.title: List Users
list_users.description: List members of the Zapier account as SCIM Users (50 per page by default), with filter, paging, sorting and attribute selection. Deactivated users are hidden. Use search_users to send the filter in a body.

filter.description: SCIM filter, e.g. userName eq "a@b.com" or id eq 1234 or userName co "@example.com". Operators: eq, co, sw, gt, ge, lt, le, and, or, parentheses.

sort_by.description: Attribute to sort by, e.g. userName.

output.description: SCIM ListResponse: totalResults, startIndex, itemsPerPage, Resources.

search_users.title: Search Users
search_users.description: Search users by POSTing a SCIM SearchRequest (filter, attributes, paging) in the body instead of the query string. Same results as list_users with filter.

filter.description: SCIM filter, e.g. userName eq "a@b.com" or id eq 1234 or userName co "@example.com". Operators: eq, co, sw, gt, ge, lt, le, and, or, parentheses.

get_user.title: Get User
get_user.description: Get one member by SCIM id: userName (email), name, displayName, emails, timezone, active and groups.

get_me.title: Get Account Owner
get_me.description: Get the SCIM User of the Zapier account owner (the API redirects to that user's endpoint).

output.description: The account owner as a SCIM User.

create_user.title: Create User
create_user.description: Provision a new member in the Zapier account. userName must be the member's email; returns 409 if a user with that email exists.

user_name.description: Email address used as the username.

active.description: Whether the user is active (default true).

replace_user.title: Replace User
replace_user.description: Overwrite all of a user's attributes (PUT); omitted attributes are cleared. Sending active=true reactivates a suspended user. Use update_user for partial changes.

update_user.title: Update User
update_user.description: Partially update a user with SCIM PatchOp operations; only add and replace are supported. E.g. deactivate with [{op:'replace',value:{active:false}}] or change email by replacing emails.

deactivate_user.title: Deactivate User
deactivate_user.description: Deprovision a member: Zapier marks the user and their team memberships inactive (not hard-deleted). They disappear from later reads; replace_user/update_user with active=true can reprovision.

list_groups.title: List Groups
list_groups.description: List teams (workspaces) as SCIM Groups, 50 per page by default, with paging, sorting, attribute selection and partial filter support.

filter.description: SCIM filter, e.g. userName eq "a@b.com" or id eq 1234 or userName co "@example.com". Operators: eq, co, sw, gt, ge, lt, le, and, or, parentheses.

sort_by.description: Attribute to sort by, e.g. userName.

search_groups.title: Search Groups
search_groups.description: Search teams by POSTing a SCIM SearchRequest (filter in the body), e.g. displayName eq "Engineering".

filter.description: SCIM filter, e.g. userName eq "a@b.com" or id eq 1234 or userName co "@example.com". Operators: eq, co, sw, gt, ge, lt, le, and, or, parentheses.

get_group.title: Get Group
get_group.description: Get one team by SCIM id, including displayName and members.

create_group.title: Create Group
create_group.description: Create a team (workspace) with a displayName and optional members. Returns 409 if the name exists.

replace_group.title: Replace Group
replace_group.description: Overwrite a team entirely (name and full member list).

update_group.title: Update Group
update_group.description: Partially update a team with SCIM PatchOp: replace displayName, add members (op add, path members), replace all members, or remove one (op remove, path members[value eq "ID"]).

delete_group.title: Delete Group
delete_group.description: Deprovision a team and remove all of its memberships.

get_service_provider_config.title: Get Service Provider Config
get_service_provider_config.description: Get Zapier's SCIM service provider configuration: which features (patch, filter, sort, bulk, etag) are supported.

list_schemas.title: List Schemas
list_schemas.description: List the SCIM schemas (User, Group) Zapier supports, with their attribute definitions.

get_schema.title: Get Schema
get_schema.description: Get one SCIM schema definition, e.g. Users or Groups, describing how users or team workspaces are formatted.

schema_id.description: Schema id: Users, Groups, or a full URN such as urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User.

list_resource_types.title: List Resource Types
list_resource_types.description: List the SCIM resource types (User, Group) with their endpoints and schemas.

get_resource_type.title: Get Resource Type
get_resource_type.description: Get one SCIM resource type (User or Group) with its endpoint and schema.

resource_type.description: Resource type name: User or Group.
